 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_regions = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_regions = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    separators = set(sep_rows) | set(sep_cols)
    color_counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                           if r not in separators and c not in separators)
    background = color_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v, n in color_counts.most_common() if v != background)
    out = [[background for _ in col_regions] for _ in row_regions]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_regions):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_regions):
            cells = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                     if grid[r][c] == marker]
            if any((r, c + 1) in cells for r, c in cells):
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
